stem: An analyst reports a business customer's price realisation as 92%, worked out from invoice prices alone. The customer also earns a volume rebate that Voltmarkt pays after each quarter. What does leaving out the rebate do to the reported realisation?

options.text: It overstates realisation, since the rebate lowers what Voltmarkt keeps
It understates realisation, since the rebate is money paid back to Voltmarkt
It leaves realisation right, since rebates are paid outside the invoice
It understates realisation, since rebates raise the list value
